overview: G'rho is a star system in the Wild Space, within the Shiritoku Spur, at galactic grid G-16, Documented in the Essential Atlas and StarWars.com galaxy map appendix..
history:
G'rho appears in galactic surveys spanning the Old Republic, Imperial era, and New Republic periods. Essential Atlas records place the system in Wild Space.

Trade lanes, sector politics, and regional conflicts shaped G'rho's role across the nine saga films, live-action series, and expanded lore.
significance: G'rho is catalogued on the official StarWars.com galaxy map and Essential Atlas appendix as part of the broader Wild Space chart.
notableEvents: Charted in the Essential Atlas appendix
Listed on the StarWars.com galaxy map
Surveyed as part of Wild Space sector records
